title: A module flat over A is flat over B when B tensor over A B maps flatly onto B

standard_prerequisites.name: A module N is flat over A if and only if tensoring with N over A is an exact functor on the category of A-modules
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: used at proof lines 30209-30214, where exactness of the functor sending N' to N tensor_A N' is deduced from flatness of N over A
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces an exact functor out of the category of B-modules as the first half of the composite that has to be shown exact.

standard_prerequisites.name: Extension of scalars along a flat ring map is exact, so tensoring with B over B tensor_A B preserves exactness
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: used at proof lines 30215-30218, where flatness of B tensor_A B to B is applied
standard_prerequisites.use: Keeps exactness when the functor is composed with the change of scalars back to B.

standard_prerequisites.name: A composite of the two functors is naturally isomorphic to tensoring with N over B, so N is flat over B
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: used at proof lines 30217-30220, where (N tensor_A N') tensor over B tensor_A B B is identified with N tensor_B N'
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the exact functor constructed with the tensor functor of N over B, which is the conclusion.

core_obligations: Assume N is flat as an A-module and consider the functor from B-modules to B tensor_A B-modules sending N' to N tensor_A N'; conclude that this functor is exact (proof lines 30209-30214).
Use the hypothesis that B tensor_A B -> B is flat to see that the further functor sending N' to (N tensor_A N') tensor over B tensor_A B B is again exact (proof lines 30215-30218).
Identify the composite functor with N' mapped to N tensor_B N', and conclude that tensoring with N over B is exact, so that N is flat as a B-module (proof lines 30217-30220).
proof_roadmap: Turn flatness of N over A into exactness of the functor N tensor_A from B-modules to B tensor_A B-modules (proof lines 30209-30214).
Compose with extension of scalars along the flat map B tensor_A B -> B, which stays exact by the hypothesis (proof lines 30215-30218).
Recognise the composite as tensoring with N over B and conclude flatness over B (proof lines 30217-30220).
difficulty_reason: The statement is a criterion used throughout the weakly etale theory: for a ring map A -> B such that B tensor_A B -> B is flat, every B-module N that is flat as an A-module is flat as a B-module (statement lines 30201-30206). The proof is short but it is a complete argument rather than a citation: flatness of N over A makes the functor N tensor_A from B-modules to B tensor_A B-modules exact, the flatness hypothesis keeps exactness after extending scalars back to B, and the composite is then identified with N tensor_B (proof lines 30209-30220). The content is the correct choice of the intermediate category and the identification of the composite functor, which is what makes the statement true without any finiteness hypothesis.
